record.paper_title: Geometric curvature energies: facts, trends, and open problems
record.context_brief: Shapes of curve minimizers and elastic knots
record.original_question: Does the round circle minimize integral Menger curvature for curves? More broadly, can one determine the actual shapes of ideal knots, of links with more than two components that minimize Möbius energy, and of global minimizers for other geometric curvature energies on curves? For elastic knots, what can be proved about nontrivial knot classes other than the (2,b)-torus knots, and what is the shape of twisted elastic knots?

evidence.quote: Open questions 2.2.13. Does the round circle minimise integral Menger curvature (2.1.5)? Can one prove more about the actual shape of ideal knots? What is the shape of links with more than two components minimising the Möbius energy? Can one identify the shapes of global minimisers of other geometric curvature energies for curves? What can be said about elastic knots for non-trivial knot classes different from (2, b)-torus knots? What is the shape of twisted elastic knots?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider rectifiable closed curves $\gamma:\mathbb{S}^1\to\mathbb{R}^3$ of fixed length. For three distinct points $x,y,z$ on the curve, let $R(x,y,z)$ denote the radius of the unique circle through these points (the circumradius), and define the (inverse) Menger curvature $c(x,y,z)=1/R(x,y,z)$. For a parameter $p\ge 2$, the integral Menger curvature is
$$\mathcal{M}_p(\gamma)=\iiint_{(\mathbb{S}^1)^3} c(\gamma(s),\gamma(t),\gamma(u))^p\,|\gamma'(s)||\gamma'(t)||\gamma'(u)|\,ds\,dt\,du.$$
Address the following questions about minimizers of geometric curvature energies on curves:

(a) Among all simple closed rectifiable curves in $\mathbb{R}^3$ of fixed length, is the round planar circle the unique minimizer of $\mathcal{M}_p$ for $p>3$ (and in particular for $p=2$ where the energy is well-defined on suitable classes)?

(b) Determine the precise geometric shape of ideal knots, i.e., minimizers within a fixed knot class of the ropelength functional $\mathcal{R}(\gamma)=\mathrm{length}(\gamma)/\Delta[\gamma]$, where $\Delta[\gamma]$ is the thickness (the largest radius $r$ such that a tube of radius $r$ around $\gamma$ is embedded).

(c) For links with three or more components in $\mathbb{R}^3$, determine the shapes of minimizers of the Möbius energy
$$E(\gamma)=\iint \Big(\frac{1}{|\gamma(s)-\gamma(t)|^2}-\frac{1}{d_\gamma(s,t)^2}\Big)|\gamma'(s)||\gamma'(t)|\,ds\,dt$$
summed over components and pairs of components, where $d_\gamma$ is the intrinsic distance.

(d) Identify global minimizing shapes for other geometric curvature energies on curves (e.g., O'Hara energies, tangent-point energies).

(e) For the elastic knot problem—minimizing the total squared curvature $\int_\gamma \kappa^2\,ds$ subject to a thickness constraint within a prescribed knot class—prove results determining the shape of minimizers for nontrivial knot classes other than the $(2,b)$-torus knots.

(f) Determine the shape of twisted elastic knots (minimizers of an elastic energy incorporating a framing/twist contribution) within nontrivial knot classes.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the round circle minimizes integral Menger curvature among closed curves is widely regarded as open; partial progress includes that the round circle is a critical point (Hermes, 2014) and recent second-variation analyses suggesting it is an isolated local minimizer, but global uniqueness, the shapes of ideal knots, Möbius-energy minimizing multi-component links, and elastic-knot minimizers for general nontrivial knot classes remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On some knot energies involving Menger curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Study of knot energies based on integral Menger curvature; minimization questions discussed.
status_evidence.claim: Minimization properties of integral Menger curvature on curves remain a topic of active research.

status_evidence.title: On the second variation of integral Menger curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Second variation analysis aimed at showing the round circle is an isolated local minimizer of integral Menger curvature.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: round circle is a critical point and (locally) an isolated minimizer, but global minimality remains open.

status_evidence.title: Menger curvature as a knot energy
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Menger-curvature knot energies and their minimization problems.
status_evidence.claim: Global minimization by the round circle is identified as an open problem.
